items.title: Retriever-Free Retrieval: Navigating Documents with Decision Models
items.description: While language models have become dramatically more capable, retrieval still largely relies on lexical matching or similarity in fixed embedding spaces. This creates a capability asymmetry: what the retriever fails to find, even the strongest generator cannot recover.
